sections.title: Use of Proceeds
sections.excerpt: Anchor USE OF PROCEEDS We intend to use the net proceeds from any sales of shares of our Common Stock pursuant to this prospectus supplement or upon physical settlement of any forward sale agreement we may enter into with any of the Forward Purchasers for general corporate purposes, including funding property acquisitions and for working capital. This expected use of the net proceeds from this offering represents our intentions based upon our current plans and business conditions. The amount and timing of our actual expenditures may vary significantly depending on numerous factors. As a result, our management will retain broad discretion over the allocation of the net proceeds we receive from this offering.
